podcast.title: Educational Software for COVID
podcast.body: The smartphone pub quiz software developed by Speed Quizzing was later adapted and utilized for remote learning in schools during the COVID-19 pandemic. "That same software was later adopted and adapted for remote learning for schools during COVID."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: From Recording Studio to Speed Quizzing
podcast.body: After leaving the British band Shed Seven in the 1990s, drummer Alan Leach initially opened a recording studio. However, he discovered a passion for trivia, leading him to host pub quizzes and eventually co-found Speed Quizzing with his brother, a company that develops and sells smartphone pub quiz software. "drummer Alan Leach left the group and opened up a recording studio. But then he realized his true passion was trivia."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
